Follow", "m01": "智者千虑，必有一失，原不必求全责备。", "m02": "世事纷纭，各有利弊，断无绝对之理。", "m03": "台面之下的规矩，从来不是文字写出来的。", "w01": "The brass lamp on the shelf flickered as the gale battered the salt-caked panes of the lighthouse. Thomas set down his ledger and reached for the glass bottle washed ashore at dawn. Inside, sealed with green wax, lay a scrap of heavy parchment bearing a single line in faded ink. It was not a plea for rescue, nor a sailor's final reckoning. It simply noted the exact date the world had stopped spinning for someone named Clara. Thomas turned the bottle over in his calloused hands, listening to the relentless surf below. He placed it carefully beside his logbook, knowing he would write no reply, yet bound by an unspoken duty to keep the light burning for a ship that had already vanished.", "w02": "街面上的青石板还留着夜露的凉意，卖早点的炉火刚腾起第一缕薄烟。远处的钟楼敲过四下，沉闷的声响在空荡的巷弄里散开。环卫工人的扫帚划过地面，发出沙沙的轻响，惊起几只觅食的雀鸟。路灯尚未熄灭，橘黄的光晕映着零星的行人，步履匆匆。整座城还在半梦半醒之间，空气里浮着一层薄薄的雾，把寻常街景衬得像一幅退了色的旧画。", "w03": "- Imagine a set of Russian nesting dolls, where each doll opens to reveal a smaller replica of itself inside.\n- A recursive function is simply a piece of code that calls a smaller, identical version of itself to solve a piece of the puzzle.\n- It must always have a stopping condition, just like the smallest doll that cannot be opened any further, so the process finally ends."}
